name: Zajchik: Drugaja Istorija
source:
Tiny Bunny: Other Story tells a tale of [url=/c92053]Anton[/url]'s alternative choices and his new relationships with friends. It reveals the characters from a different perspective, introduces an element of mystery, and invites you to immerse yourself in exploring our storylines.

Anton must decide whether to play a part in the investigation or, conversely, try to avoid the dangers lurking for him, both in the forest and among people.

[Translated from [url=https://vk.com/tinybunny_otherstory?w=club210479272]VK[/url]]
translation:
《Tiny Bunny: Other Story》讲述了[url=/c92053]安东[/url]作出不同选择、与朋友建立新关系的故事。作品从不同角度展现角色，加入神秘元素，并邀请你探索故事路线。

安东必须决定是参与调查，还是设法避开森林和人群中潜伏的危险。

[译自[url=https://vk.com/tinybunny_otherstory?w=club210479272]VK[/url]]
